sources.title: The free energy in a class of quantum spin systems and interchange processes
sources.read_depth: full model/normalization and Theorems1.1/1.2 in introduction; not full proof
sources.use: Prior free energy and first-order phase behavior. Explicit Q-to-swap normalization derived here. Not a theorem premise.
sources.priority: Does not establish absence of prior physical-product stochastic seed/full-density separability theorem.

sources.title: Exact Real Time Dynamics of Quantum Spin Systems Using the Positive-P Representation
sources.read_depth: Abstract, introduction and AppendixA equation32 onward
sources.use: Prior stochastic quantum representations; the primary equation has off-diagonal coherent kernels, so a positive probability law alone is not separability into positive local densities.
sources.priority: Substantial prior art; no absence/novelty conclusion.
